notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Timeless Witness.
description:
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to Tangled Colony.
Tangled Colony dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Tangled Colony triggers, creating thirteen 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eleven times by sacrificing eleven Rats, adding {6}{U}{U}{B}{R}{R}.
Activate Timeless Witness by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Timeless Witness.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Tangled Colony to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time, returning Shivan Meteor to your hand using Timeless Witness instead.
Cast Tangled Colony by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
